Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert  
Step Number: 17  
Reason for Mistake: The InformationExtraction_Expert incorrectly concluded that all current members of Apple's Board of Directors held C-suite positions before joining the board. This error occurred because the agent failed to properly validate the professional background of Susan L. Wagner. While Wagner was a co-founder and vice chairman of BlackRock, her position as COO does not necessarily qualify as holding a C-suite position depending on specific organizational definitions. The failure to cross-check detailed responsibilities and company hierarchy led to this overgeneralization. Moreover, the agent's reliance on incomplete contextual summaries about Susan L. Wagner's roles contributed to the incorrect conclusion. This matches the "Over-Reliance on Summaries" error pattern, where assumptions and unverified judgments are drawn from search snippets instead of performing an exhaustive validation grounded in complete evidence.
